name: Timbuktu Adventure Playground
description: An adventure playground on Grenville Road. Run by Islington Council for children aged 6 and over while it finds a long-term provider; register with the council first. Summer holidays: weekdays 10:30am to 5:30pm, with a free meal. Term-time sessions not yet confirmed.
